svg.title: Common Chain grant reservations, 2026-10-22
svg.desc: Anyone deposits to a pool. Members vote on grants. Passed proposals reserve the full ceiling if funded. Only recipients may withdraw within limits. Revocation returns unused funds atomically; after expiry anyone may trigger return to the original pool. Events and accounts track the lifecycle.
